messages:
deploy-bot: rollout finished: v2.14.7 -> canary-usw2. starting post-deploy smoke (synth probes, kvprobe, healthchecks). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/2812345679 :rocket:
claire: quick heads up — synth probe for /summarize shows a p95 bump from ~110ms to ~740ms at ~2812345690, small sample but noticeable. :eyes:
hamid: can you paste the synth lines?
claire: ```
[2812345688] synth /summarize -> 200 latency=120ms trace=tx-71aa
[2812345689] synth /summarize -> 200 latency=720ms trace=tx-71ab
[2812345690] synth /summarize -> 502 upstream_error trace=tx-71ac
```
rachel: infra metrics show a brief kvcache miss surge for prefix 'summ-ctx' and one canary host reported a short CPU steal spike at ~2812345687.
infra-bot: incident candidate flagged: synth-tail-spike (severity: low). Recommend limiting canary traffic for affected route while triage runs.
hamid: propose temporary pin of /summarize to v2.14.6 to limit blast radius. others keep v2.14.7. anyone object?
claire: +1, please apply.
qa-bot: suggested command: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /summarize --version v2.14.6 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy synth tail spike"```
hamid: applied at 2812345699. deploy-bot: routing change recorded, audit id r-audit-11234.
claire: after pin p95 returned to ~130ms within 40s, 502s cleared. good partial rollback signal.
infra-bot: collecting heap profiles, kernel-selection logs, and host telemetry from the affected canary. linking traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-71ab https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-71ac
rachel: I'll open follow-up ticket RINF-6237 "v2.14.7 summarize route tail latency" and add traces + kv heatmap; assign to serving-ops and infra. add note to release notes about the temporary pin.
hamid: action items: hamid monitor 20m, claire keep an eye on synths, infra gather diffs. escalate to full rollback if recurrence or other routes show similar pattern.
claire: 10m check-in scheduled. leaving thread open for triage notes. :white_check_mark:
